newsitem.title: USA: In Home Health Visit revenue down in Q3.
newsitem.headline: In Home Health Visit revenue down in Q3.

text.p: In Home Health Inc said Wednesday revenue at its Visit division, which provides short-term visits to a client's home, was down eight percent in the fiscal third quarter compared to a year ago.
The Extended hours, Hospice and Infusion businesses continued to show growth, with revenue in these divisions up 36 percent over the year-ago quarter.

"Although In Home Health has been successful at growing its Extended Hours, Infusion and Hospice product lines, it has failed to meet its profit expectations due to reduced Visit division volume and margin pressures," Wolfgang von Maack, president, said in a statement. "To date, the growth of the non-Medicare product lines has not produced anticipated gross profit margins."

As previously announced, the company plans to restructure its field operations, reduce costs and create a more efficient organization. The restructuring will reduce future general and administrative expenses, including rent and personnel charges.
Earlier, In Home Health reported a third quarter net loss of $0.14 a share, compared with a year-ago loss of $0.03. Revenue in the quarter amounted to $31.8 million, compared with $30.3 mmillion.
